title: Points Held Back for Cover on a Circle Release
content:
Points on a Northbeam Circle Membership are held back against money standing unsettled on the plan the
profile holds under Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans, each amount taken at the tier's value per hundred
points.

## The readings

1. Where the plan the profile holds stands active or in claim hold and a deductible stands unsettled on it, the
   points held back for cover are that unsettled deductible taken at the tier's value per hundred points.
2. Where that plan stands active or in claim hold, no deductible stands unsettled on it and a premium stands
   unsettled on it, the points held back for cover are that unsettled premium taken at the same rate.
3. Where neither of those holds, no points are held back for cover, and 0 points are taken off on this account.

## Only one amount is held back

The second reading turns on no deductible standing unsettled, so a plan carrying both an unsettled deductible
and an unsettled premium holds back the deductible alone. A plan standing in a claim hold is read exactly as
one standing active; a plan standing in any other way holds back nothing, whatever stands unsettled on it.

## Points of judgement

*A plan standing active with an unsettled deductible of 115.00 and an unsettled premium of 47.50.* The
deductible is held back, converted at the tier's value per hundred points, and the premium is not.

*A plan standing in claim hold with nothing unsettled by way of deductible and 47.50 of premium unsettled.*
The premium is held back at the same rate.

*A plan standing expired with 115.00 unsettled.* Nothing is held back for cover.

Both amounts are read on the one plan the profile holds, and each is converted at the tier's value per hundred
points: the amount is divided by that value and the figure taken times one hundred, giving a whole number of
points rounded to the nearest point.
